subject: Math
subskill: Word Problem - Setup and Solve Inequality
prompt: A company charges $$80$ per day plus a $1$-time fee of $x$ dollars to rent a piece of equipment. If the charge to rent the equipment for $2$ days is less than $$190$, what is the maximum integer value of $x$ if the company also requires that $x$ must satisfy the inequality $2x + 50 \ge 108$?
explanation: From the rental cost condition: $2(80) + x < 190$, so $160 + x < 190$, giving $x < 30$. From the company requirement: $2x + 50 \geq 108$, so $2x \geq 58$, giving $x \geq 29$. Combining these constraints: $29 \leq x < 30$. The maximum integer value satisfying both inequalities is $x = 29$.
